title: Government Debt Maturity and Term Structure of Credit Spreads
eligible_reason: Not a staggered binary DiD. Corporate-bond-level regressions of credit term spreads (ts_3y, ts_5y) on the aggregate maturity-weighted government debt to GDP (mwd_gdp, a continuous economy-wide time series) with bond, firm and macro controls, rating dummies, issuer (gvkey1) FE and year dummies; IV with month dummies as instruments. The 'exogenous event study' uses a single common date (post = offering_date >= 18 Feb 2002, the suspension of 30-year Treasury issuance; and a 2006 reintroduction date in another table) with a linear trend and controls, plus maturity-bucket x post interactions. No unit-specific adoption dates; time-varying controls and trend in every column; data not shipped.
design_notes: SAS (data preparation, Tables 1, 5, 8, 11, Figure 1) and Stata (6_Stata_Code.do, reghdfe/ivreg2). Cluster gvkey1 and offering_date. Sample: corporate bonds 1987-2015 (FISD, CRSP, Compustat, Bloomberg, FRED).

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous aggregate treatment; time-varying bond, firm and macro controls
single common event date, linear trend, controls; maturity-bucket x post interactions

data_files_note: SAS/ and Stata/ folders contain only README.txt files describing licensed datasets (FISD, CRSP, Compustat, Bloomberg, FRED); logs of the authors' runs are included.
screener_notes: Screened from package, README and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). Software is SAS plus Stata.
